theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_fcd_imp_parametric_rep
theorems.statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k), R.measure univ ≠ ∞ → ∃ (G : ℕ → Euclid k → Euclid N) (B : ℕ → Set (Euclid k)) (w : ℕ → Euclid k → ℝ), (∀ i, ∃ L : NNReal, LipschitzWith L (G i)) ∧ (∀ i, MeasurableSet (B i)) ∧ (∀ i, ∀ u ∈ B i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (G i) u) ∧ (∀ i, Measurable (w i)) ∧ (∀ i u, ∃ z : ℤ, w i u = z) ∧ (∀ i, ∀ u ∈ B i, w i u ≠ 0) ∧ (∀ i, IntegrableOn (w i) (B i)) ∧ ∑' i, ∫⁻ u in B i, ‖w i u‖ₑ * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun a b : Fin k => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (G i) u (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ))) (fderiv ℝ (G i) u (EuclideanSpace.single b (1 : ℝ)))))) ≤ R.measure univ ∧ (∀ γ : Euclid N → Covector (Euclid N) k, Continuous γ → (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x, ‖γ x‖ ≤ C) → HasSum (fun i => ∫ u in B i, w i u * γ (G i u) (fun a => fderiv ℝ (G i) u (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ)))) (R.action γ)) ∧ ∀ p : Euclid N → Prop, (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[k].restrict R.carrier), p x) → ∀ i, ∀ᵐ u ∂(volume.restrict (B i)), p (G i u)
